instructions.name: accept_counter
docs: Buyer takes the seller's counter, topping up the difference.

instructions.name: accept_trade
docs: Remaining accounts: the trade's give cards, then its want cards, in stored order.
Want cards must not be listed; clients bundle `cancel_listing` first when they are.

instructions.name: buy
docs: `expected_price` protects the buyer from a price change landing first.

instructions.name: expire_offer
docs: Anyone may refund an offer once it expires or its listing is gone.

instructions.name: make_offer
docs: Escrows `amount` lamports in the offer account. Offers are made on listed cards.

instructions.name: propose_trade
docs: Remaining accounts: the `give_count` cards the proposer gives, then the cards they want,
all in `collection`. Give cards are frozen and delegated; `add_lamports` is escrowed.
